text.text_excerpt: I loved this place, for all of the reasons listed by others and because of the salt! A little of the coffee salt (!) on the chili was amazing. The smoked alderwood salt on the sweet potato fries was really good too, as was ghost pepper. I had more fun with the salt than the sauce. And a little goes a long way bc the flavor is so intense so it's not like a sodium overload. Very decent vegan chili too. The woman working (owner?) was very nice and gave us great service as well as to he other people who walked in. So to start-- I'm not a vegan, a vegetarian, just a plain ol' fooditarian. I like literally every food on this great green earth, and the thought of limiting my options is blasphemy. When I bought a Groupon to 3 Potato 4, I was skeptical to say the least, but it sounded like a fun date idea. I promise you fellow doubters, it's totally worth it. The potatoes are delicious (I had both kinds) and the sauces are so much fun! They also have some fancy flavored salts and peppers so you can really expand your options each time you go. The service was great too! I work in Mid-City and I'm so glad to have a fun, affordable, healthy lunch option added to my week. I recommend going with a friend or ...

Didn't think fries and soup could count for a lunch but i am stuffed. Chili was better than the veggie soup just because of the uniqueness of vegan chili. Both the sweet potato and russet fries were seasoned enough I like them better alone than with the sauce. Tried aztec ketchup, pineapple chili pepper sauce and chipotle mayo. All 3 were ok, but I really like the two flavored salts - onion on the russet and bourbon sugar for the sweet potatoes. Make a honey based sauce for the sweet potatoes and i'd be in heaven. I'll be back for sure. Also like that they compost.
